sampled_roles.scope: Single selected CTA, producer issuing thread0 and consumer thread128. Thread intervals are not hardware stall counters or async transfer duration. Global timer and stores may distort local scheduling; whole-kernel overhead does not bound local distortion. Muted control includes same expanded internal ABI and no timer code. No added synchronization.

sass_marker_audit.scope: Static address intervals between actual sampled SASS CS2R globaltimer instructions. Branches/loops inside intervals need dynamic paths; register scoreboard completion not measured by timer issue.

sampled_roles.interpretation: Actual SASS places32HMMA+24LDSM in each sampled QK/dP interval; consumer product interval has64HMMA and20LDSM. The first QK interval additionally contains WARPSYNC and address setup. Timers bracket issuing-thread instruction positions, not scoreboard completion. Observer changes query registers198to178 and whole-backward time by5.31percent; stage medians are only the sampled program, not a baseline bottleneck percentage.

future_enqueue_evidence.scope: Actual profiled cubin static producer path contains future K/V TMA enqueues after current dP HMMA instructions and before first current pointwise EX2. Conditional path executes for1<=block<count-1. This proves issue order, not transfer overlap/utilization.

d128_fa2_comparison: Matched BF16 dense S4096 actual defaultSDPA kernel names identify built-in pytorch_flash forward and joint backward. CuTe control forward about0.759ms versus Flash0.834ms; CuTe query1.443ms+KV1.466ms+delta0.010ms versus Flash mainjoint1.754ms plus prep/reduceabout0.044ms. Within/between node gaps are microseconds. Separate fullprecision CuTe query/KV have8 GEMM families versus Flashjoint5; static math accounting is not utilization proof, and preserving global rawDS/rounded correction makes jointreuse nontrivial.
accuracy_contract: FP32 probabilities, external center, full rawDS and roundedDS row sums, PweightedK correction retained. No threshold relaxation. N-column distribution changes reduction association, so random graph checks alone do not qualify a candidate.
